items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Earl Palmer? He's in LA now. Oh, yeah. Big guy. George Palmer.

ctx.x: Earl Palmer, that was my favorite right drummer. Earl Palmer? He's in LA now. Oh, yeah. Big guy. George Palmer.
Yeah, George Parker, he was a good drummer, he's up there too.
